g.text: Join like-polarity FIL pins on short, symmetric traces.

g.desc: Join like-polarity FIL pins on short, symmetric traces.

g.text: R60/R61 0.1%. MLCC X7R. Minimum effective CIN/COUT: + rail 4.7 uF, - rail 10 uF.

g.desc: R60/R61 0.1%. MLCC X7R. Minimum effective CIN/COUT: + rail 4.7 uF, - rail 10 uF.

g.text: C66/C67 polymer tantalum. R62/R63 damp ringing from the battery leads.

g.desc: C66/C67 polymer tantalum. R62/R63 damp ringing from the battery leads.

g.text: One output, native gain. REF at analog zero.

g.desc: One output, native gain. REF at analog zero.

g.text: Route OUTS to COUT pad. Join CSET/COUT returns at regulator GND. U6 EP11 = GND. U7 EP13 = VN_BAT.

g.desc: Route OUTS to COUT pad. Join CSET/COUT returns at regulator GND. U6 EP11 = GND. U7 EP13 = VN_BAT.

g.text: and its own bias return (e.g. 10k from signal to LO).

g.desc: and its own bias return (e.g. 10k from signal to LO).

g.text: R4-R7: 0R standard. Fit 22-33R as needed after noise tests.

g.desc: R4-R7: 0R standard. Fit 22-33R as needed after noise tests.

g.text: Use a precharged, low-energy input. Hot-plug in MEAS is unrated.

g.desc: Use a precharged, low-energy input. Hot-plug in MEAS is unrated.

g.text: Example: allow at least 5.3 min for a 7 V step to decay to 0.5 mV.

g.desc: Example: allow at least 5.3 min for a 7 V step to decay to 0.5 mV.

g.text: At 7 V, PRE draws up to 0.47 mA initially and tau is about 33 s.

g.desc: At 7 V, PRE draws up to 0.47 mA initially and tau is about 33 s.

g.text: Place 100n C0G and local bulk close to each stage.

g.desc: Place 100n C0G and local bulk close to each stage.

g.text: EXT SAFE / precharge provided by the selector board.

g.desc: EXT SAFE / precharge provided by the selector board.

g.text: J1 for positive zener DC only. J2 requires external AC coupling

g.desc: J1 for positive zener DC only. J2 requires external AC coupling

g.text: Use PRE before connecting J1, changing DUT voltage, or power-off.

g.desc: Use PRE before connecting J1, changing DUT voltage, or power-off.
